title: Storm Star

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Storm Star is the upgraded form of Flametal mace using the Iolite. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Iolite, they gain 10 lightning damage and their hit effect has a 25% chance to apply Chain Lightning.
An upgraded Storm Star will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.
